title: Handling of APN based congestion control

entities.name: APN based congestion control
entities.description: Network procedure for detecting and managing APN congestion. The network may reject session management requests or disconnect existing PDN connections with cause #26 when active.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: EPS session management timer for APN based congestion control, started and stopped on a per APN basis in the UE.

entities.name: APN
entities.description: Access Point Name used for PDN connection establishment and congestion control association.

entities.name: No APN
entities.description: Condition when UE does not provide an APN in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST or ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE.

entities.name: Emergency PDN connection
entities.description: Special PDN connection type not affected by APN congestion control when no APN is associated.

entities.name: APN congestion back-off time
entities.description: Time value stored by network on per UE and congested APN basis during congestion control.

entities.name: ESM cause #26
entities.description: Cause value 'insufficient resources' used when network rejects session management requests during APN congestion.

relations.description: Network may store APN congestion back-off time when performing congestion control.
Network may reject requests or disconnect connections with ESM cause #26 during congestion control.
Timer T3396 is associated with and operates on a per APN basis.
Timer T3396 can be associated with no APN when UE doesn't provide APN.
Timer T3396 associated with no APN does not affect emergency PDN connections.
APN based congestion control triggers starting of timer T3396 in the UE.
